summary: R2 secure LLM micro-pilot completed. G0/G1/G2 offline gates PASS. 4 DeepSeek episodes run (2 scenarios x 2 arms) at $0.074 cost. All score deltas zero. NO-GO for strategy transfer at current budget. DiscoveryWorld suitable for multi-step decisions but LLM agent needs better prompting/more steps.

tests.notes: 114 tests: 10 G0 isolation/canary, 22 R2R1 adapter, 13 R2B adapter, 14 R3 scoring, 12 R2 downloader, 19 R1 evaluator, 24 safeguards

acceptance_detail.R2R2-01: No hidden data in model input. Canary tests pass. Old seeds quarantined. Trusted files untracked.
acceptance_detail.R2R2-02: Official action schema working. Real PICKUP scientific action demonstrated. Feedback-dependent decisions shown.
acceptance_detail.R2R2-03: Same LLM agent for both arms. Pre-registration frozen. Only strategy text differs.
acceptance_detail.R2R2-05: 4 matched LLM episodes completed with real scores (all zero) and replayable traces.
acceptance_detail.R2R2-06: Spend $0.074 <= $1.0. DeepSeek key configured locally. No secrets in repo.
acceptance_detail.R2R2-07: Hand-authored exploratory pilot. No learned transfer claimed. No unsupported statistics.

decision_rationale: Uniform zero score deltas across 4 episodes. No substantive scientific interaction by LLM agent. Movement actions dominate. Task complexity exceeds single-shot LLM capability at current budget.
limitations: All score deltas zero — no meaningful outcome variation
Low valid action rate (4-10 per episode)
Single-shot LLM calls (no self-debug or iteration)
